proposition: The closing section of the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk teaches that the fate of a person or thing can be read from his or its name and honorific, cites Ibn Barrajān's Jerusalem prediction with Ibn ʿArabī's calculation and Saʿd al-Dīn Ḥamuvayī's cryptic method (declining to go into the latter in an introductory work), and dismisses Ascendant-from-name methods as mere approximation from experience.
